content: Cefadroxil for Oral Suspension, USP, is available in the following formulations: 1. 125 mg per 5 mL suspension: This formulation contains cefadroxil monohydrate equivalent to 125 mg. It is provided as a light orange-colored powder that forms an orange suspension when reconstituted with water. The resulting suspension has a characteristic mixed fruit flavor. It is supplied in 100 mL bottles with the NDC code 63304-972-04. 2. 250 mg per 5 mL suspension: This formulation contains cefadroxil monohydrate equivalent to 250 mg. It is provided as a light orange-colored powder that forms an orange suspension when reconstituted with water. The resulting suspension has a characteristic mixed fruit flavor. It is available in: 50 mL bottles with the NDC code 63304-973-03. 100 mL bottles with the NDC code 63304-973-04. 3. 500 mg per 5 mL suspension: This formulation contains cefadroxil monohydrate equivalent to 500 mg. It is provided as a light orange-colored powder that forms an orange suspension when reconstituted with water. The resulting suspension has a characteristic mixed fruit flavor. It is available in: 75 mL bottles with the NDC code 63304-974-01. 100 mL bottles with the NDC code 63304-974-04. Important Instructions for Use: Shake the oral suspension well before each use. Keep the bottle tightly closed at all times. After reconstitution, store the suspension in a refrigerator. Any unused portion of the reconstituted suspension must be discarded after 14 days. Storage Conditions: Before reconstitution, store the product at 20–25°C (68–77°F) in accordance with USP Controlled Room Temperature guidelines.
